Package Name: Unspecified malicious packages related to Crypto
Method of Attack: Threat actors publishing malicious packages related to Crypto on NPM. The malicious code within these packages would execute upon package installation and fetch a second-stage payload from a remote location
Attack Vector: Exploitation of trust in shared code repositories

Package Name: Malicious NPM packages from GitHub repository
Method of Attack: Threat actors created multiple identities to host several GitHub repositories. These victims were tricked into downloading malicious NPM packages directly from a GitHub repository, disguised as job interview tasks. These packages, once installed, release malware that compromises the user’s computer, steals sensitive data, goes after cryptocurrency wallets, and establishes a backdoor for ongoing access
Discoverer: Unspecified, Reddit users sharing their experiences
Attack Vector: Exploitation of trust in GitHub as a reliable source for software tools
Indicators of Compromise: Unspecified malicious NPM packages from GitHub repository
